Several dungeon sources appear three times in the game (probably the three difficulties); listed once here. Rarity = the item's background colour (Orange, Purple, Blue, Green, Grey), read by eye. items.name: Forbidden Grimoire
items.description: A grimoire containing forbidden knowledge. Created by a pioneer, this pitch-black grimoire contains inscriptions that only the chosen ones can read. It is said that those who read these inscriptions can achieve Ascension.

items.name: Chronograph of Ages
items.description: A mysterious hourglass that holds the very essence of flowing time. Though the sand flows from top to bottom, the time neither decreases nor accumulates. It is said that this tool, which seems to have stopped the flow of time, evokes a strange sensation where the past and future are intertwined.

items.name: Arcana of the Future
items.description: An Arcana depicting the form of a human. It tells the story of the era yet to be forged. “Though a time of struggle may flow for now, in the future! The future we will someday reach! The Age of the Goddess, with the awakened Goddess by our side, will return!"

items.name: Raw Mana Stone
items.description: A legendary magic ore containing infinite potential. Imbued with memories of various pieces of equipment, it possesses the mysterious ability to change its form to match the equipment being enhanced.

items.name: Insignia of the Orbis Kingdom
items.description: A golden token engraved with the Insignia of the Orbis Kingdom. It symbolizes the dedication and honor of the Royal Knights, and the token holds the memories of countless battles fought in defense of the kingdom. These memories can only be shared by those deeply connected to the Knights, and only to them does the token's true power manifest.

items.name: Insignia of the Organa Order
items.description: A blue token engraved with the Insignia of the Organa Order. It symbolizes the sanctity and devotion of the Order, and the token is imbued with the Goddess's blessings and the Order's glorious history. This mystical power manifests only in those with a deep bond to the Order, bestowing special value upon those who follow the Goddess's will.

items.name: Insignia of the Johnny Mercenaries
items.description: A green insignia engraved with the Insignia of the Johnny Mercenaries. It symbolizes the strong will and solidarity of the Mercenary Crew, as pursued by its captain, Johnny. The insignia contains the condensed memories of countless battles the Crew has fought. These memories can only be shared by members of the Crew, and the insignia's power is only unleashed upon them.

items.name: Insignia of the Red Fox Mercenaries
items.description: A red insignia engraved with a fox. Its intense glow symbolizes the passion and unity of the Mercenary Crew pursued by Captain Roxy. The insignia contains the condensed memories of countless battles the Crew has fought. These memories can only be shared by members of the Crew, and the insignia's power is only activated for them.

items.name: Insignia of the Lentus Rebellion Army
items.description: Insignia of the Lentus Rebellion Army engraved with a lion emblem. This blood-stained insignia symbolizes the Rebellion Army's indomitable will and their yearning for freedom. The insignia embodies the history of the struggles the Rebellion Army has endured, and it unleashes its true power only to those deeply allied with the Rebellion Army.

items.name: Tome of Insight
items.description: A grimoire containing the insights of past warriors. It helps you inherit their strength and will by reading the insights accumulated over many years. But remember, a hero is not made simply by reading a book.

items.name: Secret Text of Victory
items.description: A tome containing strategies and wisdom for certain victory. However, simply reading this book will not make you the strongest. You must constantly strive and train based on this knowledge to achieve true victory, so do not rely solely on the tome.

items.name: Arcana of Peace
items.description: An Arcana depicting the goddess. It tells the story of the goddess who fell into a deep slumber after a fierce battle with the Dark Dragon. “Everything is as it should be. That is the flow and the will of the universe. Therefore, soon..."

items.name: Mana Ore
items.description: A lump of magical ore so rare that even renowned artisans rarely see it. The sparks that fly when it is reforged emit a beautiful glow, making it regarded as a precious work of art in its own right.

items.name: Spiny Fin
items.description: A spiny fin that fell from the head of a giant starving ghost. Normally folded, it unfolds menacingly when the creature is hunting or agitated. The hard, sharp spines retain their intensity over time, reminding observers of the starving ghost's grotesque appearance.

items.name: Blood-stained Hook
items.description: A hook far too massive for a human to wield. As if frozen in the very moment it mercilessly snatched its prey, a faint scent of blood wafts from the tip of the hook. The traces that remain, undimmed by the passage of time, hint at just how many lives this hook has taken.

items.name: Sage's Blood
items.description: Born when the blood of a once-great sage merged with the power of a dragon. This blood, which neither cools nor congeals over time, flows endlessly, resembling the primordial power that yearns for circulation. The sage's memories have melted away into this blood, but his power alone still lingers within.

items.name: Tangled Memories and Reminiscences
items.description: A mysterious substance formed from the intertwining of memories and recollections. When a genius blacksmith used this substance to craft armor, its performance skyrocketed, yet no one has been able to uncover the principle behind it. The genius blacksmith speculated that the reason might be someone's desperate memory of yearning for power, contained within the crystal.

items.name: Advanced Combat Text
items.description: A book containing advanced knowledge necessary for full-scale combat. It systematically covers the techniques and strategies required in actual battle, making it an essential reference for warriors looking to advance to the next level. However, be especially careful, as the dry writing style may make you drowsy while reading.

items.name: Secret Text of the Warrior
items.description: A mysterious scroll containing the requirements to become a warrior. While it appears to be simple text at first glance, a closer read reveals secrets and practical tips for becoming a powerful warrior. It is said that its meaning varies depending on the reader, and those who fully comprehend it can reach new heights on the battlefield.

items.name: Arcana of Beginnings
items.description: An Arcana of Beginnings depicting the beginning of history. It tells the story of the conclusion of the battle between the Goddess and the Dark Dragon. “The shards of power born from the collision spread throughout this world, heralding the dawn of a new era."

items.name: Mana Crystal
items.description: A Mana Crystal widely used for enhancing various equipment. It maintains a small yet solid crystalline form, making it easy to handle and significantly increasing the efficiency of the enhancement process.

items.name: Intermediate Monster Hide
items.description: Intermediate Monster Hide. This intermediate monster hide stands out for its soft and supple texture. It's easy to process and boasts excellent durability, making it extremely popular for crafting armor. It's in high demand in the market and trades actively, being reborn as magnificent works in the hands of skilled artisans. It is used as a material to boost strength and enhance combat skills.

items.name: Intermediate Monster Carapace
items.description: A massive carapace that once encased the monster's skin. With few scars and cleanly removed, it holds high market value. Its hard, smooth surface seems to confidently proclaim, ‘I'm still going strong!) It is used as a material to boost strength and enhance combat skills.

items.name: Crystal of Remembrance
items.description: A mysterious crystal said to contain all memories. It is said that holding this crystal in your hand preserves everything—from memories you wish to forget to those you never want to lose. Though exactly how this crystal works remains a mystery, it is said that once used, one can never forget its weight and depth.

items.name: Crystal of Recollection
items.description: A crystal said to capture one's most cherished moments. It is said that simply gazing at the crystal brings back long-forgotten happy memories, warming the heart. However, that sense of happiness does not linger long, so people refer to this crystal as ‘brief but intense happiness.,

items.name: Crystal of Reverie
items.description: A crystal of Remembrance said to evoke recent memories. It is said that gazing at it helps you recall the location of recently lost items or things you've forgotten. While it feels like piecing together lost fragments one by one, it is also said that sometimes it brings back memories you'd rather not recall.

items.name: Crystal of Oblivion
items.description: An ominous Crystal of Remembrance said to erase all memories. It is said that while gazing at it, one can feel the memories in their mind slowly fading away. Though it may appear to be a comforting object that covers past pain, many warn that only an empty void remains in its wake.

items.name: Fruit of Vitality
items.description: A mysterious Fruit of Vitality said to restore vitality to the body simply by eating it. The life force condensed within is said to be powerful enough to revive even the fallen. It possesses a sweet yet refreshing taste, and ancient legends tell of people who set out on adventures to obtain this fruit.

items.name: Primordial Seed
items.description: A precious Primordial Seed said to contain the essence of the primordial age. Despite its small and ordinary appearance, it is said to harbor unimaginable potential within. It is a mysterious object that seems capable of manifesting powerful life energy simply by being planted.

items.name: Drop of Purity
items.description: A mysterious flower that holds tiny droplets within its petals. Even in fierce wind and rain, the petals protect the droplets and do not fall, making it a symbol of untainted purity. The clear droplets within seem to hold the essence of pure life, evoking both wonder and awe in those who behold them.

items.name: Leaf of Vigor
items.description: The leaf of a mysterious plant that has grown imbued with magical power. It is said that consuming it allows one to feel a powerful force welling up from deep within the body. However, excessive consumption can actually be toxic to the body, so it is wise to stop at a moderate amount.

items.name: Intermediate Amplitude Stone
items.description: A precious stone that draws out the owner's potential to an even greater degree. The pattern emits a subtle glow, and if it matches the user's abilities, the power dormant within the stone becomes more clearly evident. It severely disrupts the enemy's consciousness, causing confusion and dizziness.
items.use: Used for Karma Breakthrough and Equipment Crafting

items.name: Intermediate Crushing Stone
items.description: A precious stone that further unlocks the owner's potential. The pattern emits a subtle glow, and if it matches the user's abilities, the power dormant within the stone becomes more clearly evident. It presses down heavily on the enemy's body, forcing them to kneel and fall.
items.use: Used for Karma Breakthrough and equipment crafting

items.name: Intermediate Gale Stone
items.description: A precious stone that further unlocks the owner's potential. The pattern emits a subtle glow, and if it matches the user's abilities, the power dormant within the stone becomes more clearly evident. It uses its immense power to launch the enemy high into the air, keeping them suspended there.
items.use: Used for Karma Breakthrough and equipment crafting

items.name: Intermediate Breaker Stone
items.description: A precious stone that further unlocks the owner's potential. The pattern emits a subtle glow, and if it matches the user's abilities, the power dormant within the stone becomes more clearly evident. It shatters the enemy's defenses with a powerful shock, exposing their weaknesses.
items.use: Used for Karma Breakthrough and equipment crafting

items.name: Intermediate Blazeflame Stone
items.description: A precious stone that further unlocks the owner's potential. The pattern emits a subtle glow, and if it matches the user's abilities, the power dormant within the stone becomes more clearly evident. Intense flames engulf the enemy, inflicting sustained burns.
items.use: Used for Karma Breakthrough and equipment crafting

items.name: Intermediate Frostbite Stone
items.description: A precious stone that further unlocks the owner's potential. The pattern emits a subtle glow, and if it aligns with the user's abilities, the power dormant within the stone becomes more clearly evident. The power of frost freezes enemies solid, immobilizing them.
items.use: Used for Karma Breakthrough and equipment crafting

items.name: Intermediate Thunderbolt Stone
items.description: A precious stone that further unlocks the owner's potential. The pattern emits a subtle glow, and if it matches the user's abilities, the power dormant within the stone becomes more clearly evident. A powerful surge of lightning shocks the enemy, causing their body to tremble.
items.use: Used for Karma Breakthrough and equipment crafting

items.name: Red Pyroxene
items.description: A mysterious substance found within the bodies of powerful monsters. Since its formation process remains unknown, it is commonly referred to as a monster's gallstone. It boasts exceptional hardness and is primarily used in the crafting of armor. Its distinctive red hue is believed to be a trace of condensed monster power, adding to its decorative value and making it highly prized.

items.name: Basic Combat Text
items.description: A textbook covering the fundamentals of combat. Filled with the basic knowledge and skills needed in actual battle, reading this book alone is enough to allow you to confidently call yourself a warrior anywhere. It is considered an essential guide for beginners.

items.name: Record of Battle
items.description: An antique scroll containing records of countless battles. The moment you unroll it, the fierce battlefield and the heroes' valor come vividly to life. It is said that simply reading it makes the tactics and strategies of battle seem to seep into your mind.

items.name: Arcana of War
items.description: An Arcana of War depicting the beginning of the Great War. It tells the story of a dragon that rebelled against the Goddess. “Darkness devoured the light, devoured life, and stretched its evil claws toward the Goddess."

items.name: Mana Shard
items.description: A magic fragment used by apprentice blacksmiths. It contains many impurities, making it difficult to work with. As a material requiring delicate handling, it is a particularly challenging task for beginners.

items.name: Low-Grade Monster Essence
items.description: Low-Grade Monster Essence, it glistens inside a small vial. It's a material that novice mercenaries treasure and collect, depending on how it's used, the ordinary can become extraordinary. The saying, 'One vial isn't enough to make you strong, but ten vials are a different story,, didn't come out of nowhere. It is used as a material to boost strength and enhance combat skills.

items.name: Low-grade Monster Hide
items.description: Low-grade monster hide. While less stiff, this low-grade monster hide still feels somewhat lacking, leaving a sense of disappointment. It's often seen in the market, but few buyers are interested. Still, rumor has it that with proper preparation, it can be quite useful—so why not give it a try and see what you can do with it? Used as a material to boost strength and enhance combat skills.

items.name: Low-grade Monster Bone Fragment
items.description: A shattered bone fragment from a low- tier monster. It is said that the condition of the bone reveals the skill level of the mercenary who hunted it. Whether it is a source of pride or a trace of failure, this single fragment seems to hold its own story. It is used as a material to boost strength and enhance combat skills.

items.name: Low-Grade Monster Carapace
items.description: A carapace that protected the monster's skin. It looks clean at first glance, but upon closer inspection, it is densely covered with tiny scars. It feels as though it is subtly boasting, ‘I'm covered in wounds, but | held up pretty well., It is used as a material to boost strength and enhance combat skills.

items.name: Low-Grade Monster Claw
items.description: A sharp monster claw. It's serviceable enough to use as a weapon in a pinch. However, if you misjudge the direction, you might end up hurting yourself first. You might end up learning the lesson ‘Always be careful with claws!) It is used as a material to boost power and enhance combat skills.

items.name: Binding Crystal
items.description: A hard ore with a unique crystalline structure that disperses impact. It effectively absorbs and distributes strong external blows, making it an indispensable material for armor crafting. Its hardness and durability remain unchanged over time, making it particularly favored by artisans seeking to maximize defensive capabilities on the battlefield.

items.name: Piercing Crystal
items.description: A special ore with a pointed shape that is easy to sharpen. Its excellent workability makes it ideal for crafting or enhancing sharp weapons. Thanks to its unique hardness and sharpness, it retains its edge even after prolonged use. Piercing Crystal is regarded by craftsmen as an essential material for creating the finest weapons.

items.name: Low-Grade Amplitude Stone
items.description: A small stone with the basic ability to stimulate the owner's latent power. The pattern engraved on the stone glows faintly, allowing the user to confirm their harmony with their own energy. It slightly disrupts the enemy's consciousness, causing them to lose their balance for a brief moment.
items.use: Used for Karma Breakthrough and Equipment Crafting

items.name: Low-Grade Crushing Stone
items.description: A small stone with basic properties that stimulate the owner's latent power. The pattern engraved on the stone glows faintly, allowing the user to confirm harmony with their own energy. It momentarily makes the enemy's legs stagger, causing them to lose their balance.
items.use: Used for Karma Breakthrough and Equipment Crafting

items.name: Low-Grade Gale Stone
items.description: A small stone with basic abilities that stimulate the owner's latent power. The pattern engraved on the stone glows faintly, allowing the user to confirm harmony with their own energy. It causes the enemy's body to rise slightly, causing them to lose their balance.
items.use: Used for Karma Breakthrough and equipment crafting

items.name: Low-Grade Breaker Stone
items.description: A small stone with basic properties that stimulate the owner's latent power. The pattern engraved on the stone glows faintly, allowing the user to confirm harmony with their own energy. It slightly disrupts the enemy's defense, creating an opening.
items.use: Used for Karma Breakthrough and equipment crafting

items.name: Low-Grade Bloodburst Stone
items.description: A small stone with basic properties that stimulate the owner's latent power. The pattern engraved on the stone glows faintly, allowing the user to confirm harmony with their own energy. It tears the enemy's wounds slightly deeper, leaving traces of pain.
items.use: Used for Karma Breakthrough and equipment crafting

items.name: Low-Grade Blazeflame Stone
items.description: A small stone with basic abilities that stimulate the owner's latent power. The pattern engraved on the stone glows faintly, allowing the user to confirm harmony with their own energy. It lightly sears the enemy's skin, leaving behind searing pain.
items.use: Used for Karma Breakthrough and Equipment Crafting

items.name: Low-Grade Frostbite Stone
items.description: A small stone with basic abilities that stimulate the owner's latent power. The pattern engraved on the stone glows faintly, allowing the user to confirm harmony with their own energy. A cold aura temporarily slows the enemy's movements.
items.use: Used for Karma Breakthrough and Equipment Crafting

items.name: Low-Grade Thunderbolt Stone
items.description: A small stone with basic abilities that stimulate the owner's latent power. The pattern engraved on the stone glows faintly, allowing the user to confirm harmony with their own energy. A faint electric current brushes against the enemy's body, causing mild paralysis.
items.use: Used for Karma Breakthrough and equipment crafting

items.name: Lowest-Grade Monster Essence
items.description: Lowest-Grade Monster Essence. It is common since it can be easily obtained from weak monsters, but as the saying goes, 'Small beginnings lead to great things;—the more you learn about it, the more interesting this material becomes. They say it's the most commonly found treasure in novice mercenaries’ pockets. It is used as a material to boost strength and enhance combat skills.

items.name: Lowest-Grade Monster Hide
items.description: The stiff and tough hide of a low-tier monster, likely due to malnutrition. Though difficult to work with and sold cheaply, novice mercenaries always seem to have a sheet or two in their bags. They say this hide has its uses if handled properly, so don't throw it away—give it a try. Used as a material to boost strength and enhance combat skills.

items.name: Lowest-Grade Monster Bone Fragment
items.description: Broken bone fragments from low-tier monsters. These are primarily obtained from monsters composed of bone, and judging by their shattered appearance, they seem to have taken quite a heavy blow. They are one of the common spoils of war that novice mercenaries proudly bring back, exclaiming, “I did it!" They are used as materials to boost strength and enhance combat skills.

items.name: Lowest-Grade Monster Carapace
items.description: A small piece of carapace that once covered a monster's skin. Deep scars from frequent battles and rough, torn edges are clearly visible. Although it is hard, its appearance makes it difficult to value highly. It seems to say, 'I used to be in good shape, too., It is used as a material to boost strength and enhance combat skills.

items.name: Lowest-Grade Monster Claw
items.description: A monster's claw with a blunt tip and missing teeth. It's hard to call it threatening, but a claw is still a claw. If you let your guard down while handling it, you might end up with a surprisingly painful experience. Be careful if you don't want this to end up as a laughing matter with people asking, 'Is that all it took to hurt you?, It is used as a material to boost strength and enhance combat skills.
